note: Code families used by canonical tables and marts. Codes live here, never in transform code. Each family cites its public source; HEDIS value-set names are given for alignment, but these lists are documentation-level code families, not licensed NCQA value sets. Codes marked retired are kept so historical claims still classify.

mammography.label: Screening and diagnostic mammography (incl. DBT)
citations: NCQA HEDIS MY2025 Breast Cancer Screening (BCS-E), value set 'Mammography'
AMA CPT 2017 code changes: 77065-77067 replaced G0202/G0204/G0206 (CMS MLN MM9862)

colonoscopy.label: Colonoscopy (screening and diagnostic)
citations: NCQA HEDIS MY2025 Colorectal Cancer Screening (COL-E), value set 'Colonoscopy'
CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual ch.18 sec.60 (G0105 high risk, G0121 average risk)

fit.label: Fecal occult blood / fecal immunochemical test
citations: NCQA HEDIS MY2025 COL-E, value set 'FOBT Lab Test' / 'FOBT Test Result or Finding'
CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual ch.18 sec.60 (G0328 immunoassay FOBT)

fit_dna.label: Stool DNA with FIT (sDNA-FIT)
citations: NCQA HEDIS MY2025 COL-E, value set 'sFIT-DNA Lab Test'
CMS NCD 210.3 Colorectal Cancer Screening Tests

awv.label: Medicare Annual Wellness Visit and Welcome to Medicare (IPPE)
citations: CMS MLN6775421 Medicare Wellness Visits (G0402 IPPE, G0438 initial AWV, G0439 subsequent AWV)

a1c.label: Hemoglobin A1c test
citations: NCQA HEDIS MY2025 Glycemic Status Assessment for Patients With Diabetes (GSD), value sets 'HbA1c Lab Test' and 'HbA1c Level' CPT II
LOINC 4548-4 Hemoglobin A1c/Hemoglobin.total in Blood

flu_vaccine.label: Influenza vaccine product and administration
citations: CDC CVX code set (https://www2a.cdc.gov/vaccines/iis/iisstandards/vaccines.asp?rpt=cvx)
NCQA HEDIS MY2025 Adult Immunization Status (AIS-E), value sets 'Adult Influenza Immunization' / 'Adult Influenza Vaccine Procedure'
CMS MLN Influenza vaccine payment allowances (G0008 administration)

ed_revenue.label: Emergency department revenue codes
citations: NUBC UB-04 Data Specifications Manual, FL 42 revenue codes 045X Emergency Room, 0981 Professional fees-ER
NCQA HEDIS MY2025 'ED' value set (UBREV 0450-0452, 0456, 0459, 0981)

ed_em.label: Emergency department E/M and critical care
citations: AMA CPT Emergency Department Services 99281-99285
CMS Place of Service code set: 23 Emergency Room - Hospital

observation.label: Hospital observation stay
citations: NUBC UB-04 revenue code 076X Specialty Services (0762 Observation Hours)
CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual ch.4 sec.290 Outpatient Observation Services (G0378, G0379)
AMA CPT 2023: observation codes 99217-99220, 99224-99226 deleted and merged into 99221-99239

tob_families.label: Type of bill families (first three digits; fourth digit = frequency)
citations: NUBC UB-04 Data Specifications Manual, FL 04 Type of Bill
CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual ch.25 sec.75.1 (TOB)
X12 837 CLM05-3 claim frequency type codes 1/7/8

pos_groups.label: Place of service groups (professional claims)
citations: CMS Place of Service Code Set (https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/place-of-service-codes/code-sets)

claim_status.label: Final adjudication statuses (payer perspective) and how versions.py derives them
citations: NCPDP Telecommunication Standard reject codes (511-FB)
X12 835 CARC code list (CO-27, CO-45, CO-50, CO-129, CO-197)
